summary: The copy sounds like DUMMIES: dry, instrument-like, and every value has a parameter ID. Cue priority, reserved red, matte marks and the spent-versus-scored distinction all hold. Two small data defects remain: the drone-dispatch event has no particles even though its own reference and the drop param describe dust, and the brake-mark speed gate uses a canvas unit for a simulation speed.

issues.rule: The drone lifts the cone over `proto.droneLiftSeconds`, and the drop param says dust plays when a drone lifts. The event reference promises rotor-wash dust, so the empty particle list contradicts both.
Render scaling must not change simulation units. Car speed is a simulation quantity in world units/s (DRIVER#DB1), not canvas units/s.
